description:
🌿 Welcome to Villa Serenita — An architectural paradise tucked in the serene bylanes of Anjuna, North Goa! ✨

Designed for refined tropical living, this luxurious 3BHK private pool villa blends contemporary minimalism with warm bohemian aesthetics. Step through floor-to-ceiling glass sliding doors onto a private sun-drenched pool deck framed by towering palm trees.

Enjoy ultra-fast fiber WiFi 💻, 65" 4K Smart TV 📺, private chef on request 👨‍🍳, ensuite rain showers 🚿, and a gourmet open-plan kitchen. Whether hosting intimate family gatherings or escaping for a peaceful luxury retreat, Villa Serenita is your ultimate sanctuary. 🏡

📍 Just 5 minutes to Anjuna Beach, curated cafés, and vibrant coastal dining!

Book your unforgettable Goan getaway today! 🌊🌴
